lead.tldr: Bitcoin resets with whale selling and leverage flush, Sharpe ratio at bear market lows. • South Korea launches 2026 crypto probes, targeting exchanges and Digital Asset Act. • Fed weighs skinny master accounts as crypto firms clash with banks on access. • Block cuts 10% staff amid Cash App-Square integration and Bitcoin mining push. • Bithumb writes off $9M Bitcoin after giveaway error triggers regulatory probe. • Stablecoins eyed to finance AI infrastructure via US Treasury holdings.

top_signals.title: Bitcoin enters a reset phase: Whales sell as BTC leverage gets flushed
top_signals.summary: Bitcoin is entering a reset phase as large whales, including the Hyperunit wallet linked to Garrett Jin, sell substantial holdings, with over $340 million in BTC sent to Binance and positions dropping from a peak of $11.5 billion to $2.2 billion. This deleveraging follows the unraveling of aggressive leveraged bets on BTC, ETH, and Solana, which incurred heavy losses and exposed risks amid weak market signals and ETF outflows. For institutional investors, the selling signals a shift toward caution and capital preservation, potentially stabilizing prices after profit-taking from coins acquired near $50,000 while derivatives markets see rising perp exposure. This reset may create opportunities for selective accumulation, as some whales quietly add BTC during dips near $71,000-$73,000 despite broader spot weakness.

top_signals.title: South Korea Prepares Crypto Market Probes Under 2026 Policy Plan
top_signals.summary: South Korea's Financial Supervisory Service (FSS) is preparing to conduct crypto market probes as part of its 2026 policy plan. The plan includes targeted probes, exchange oversight measures, and groundwork for the Digital Asset Basic Act.

top_signals.title: Crypto, Banks Give Input to Fed ‘Skinny Master Account’ Idea
top_signals.summary: The Federal Reserve is considering input on its "skinny master account" proposal, with crypto firms and banks disagreeing on the level of access the crypto sector should have to the central bank.

top_signals.title: Jack Dorsey's Block reportedly cutting up to 10% of workforce in latest efficiency push: Bloomberg
top_signals.summary: Block, led by Jack Dorsey, is reportedly cutting up to 10% of its workforce as part of an efficiency drive. This follows a previous layoff of 931 employees in March 2025.

top_signals.title: Russian officials are warning Putin that a financial crisis could arrive this summer, report says, while his war on Ukraine becomes too big to fail
top_signals.summary: Russian officials are reportedly warning Putin about a potential financial crisis this summer due to the ongoing war in Ukraine. The article suggests the war has become too significant for Putin to back down from.

top_signals.title: Crypto.com CEO Kris Marszalek bought AI.com for $70 million in crypto, plans Super Bowl debut
top_signals.summary: Crypto.com CEO Kris Marszalek purchased the domain AI.com for $70 million in cryptocurrency. The purchase is reported to be the largest domain name transaction in history, and the company plans a Super Bowl debut.

top_signals.title: The Electric Dollar: How Stablecoins Will Finance AI's Future by Messari's Unqualified Opinions
top_signals.summary: A discussion on how stablecoin issuers like Tether and Circle are becoming significant holders of US Treasuries and how this could finance AI infrastructure growth. The conversation explores the potential of on-chain capital markets to unlock trillions in AI CapEx and the future of DePIN.

top_signals.title: Bitcoin Sharpe Ratio Hits Bear Market Lows At Negative 10
top_signals.summary: Bitcoin's Sharpe ratio has fallen to its lowest level since March 2023, indicating risk-reward levels similar to previous bear market bottoms. This suggests increased risk relative to potential returns for Bitcoin investments.

top_signals.title: ENS Abandons Its planned Namechain L2, Citing Drastically Lower Gas Costs
top_signals.summary: ENS has decided to abandon its planned Namechain L2 solution. The decision was made due to the significant reduction in gas costs and the rapid scaling of the Ethereum mainnet.

top_signals.summary: Wintermute provided feedback to the SEC Crypto Task Force regarding tokenized securities, offering recommendations for market development. The feedback aims to provide practical guidance for the tokenized securities markets.

top_signals.title: Bithumb to write off $9 million in Bitcoin losses after giveaway gaffe
top_signals.summary: Bithumb is writing off $9 million in Bitcoin losses after mistakenly handing out $40 billion in Bitcoin during a giveaway, leading to price drops. Finance regulators are reportedly launching a probe into Bithumb's offices, and the company will compensate affected traders.

top_signals.title: Jack Dorsey’s Block May Slash Up To 10% of Staff: Report
top_signals.summary: Block, led by Jack Dorsey, is reportedly considering laying off up to 10% of its staff as part of a restructuring effort. The company is integrating Cash App with Square and expanding into Bitcoin mining and AI projects.

linkedin_post: Dear Founders, Investors, and Friends, The crypto landscape is shifting beneath our feet, and the signals are unmistakable. Bitcoin is entering a reset phase as major whales reduce leverage and rebalance positions, with over $340 million in BTC flowing to exchanges. This deleveraging follows aggressive bets that unwound amid market pressure, exposing the risks of overleveraged strategies. Yet within this correction lies opportunity. Selective accumulation near $71,000-$73,000 is already happening quietly among sophisticated players who recognize that resets create entry points for disciplined investors. Simultaneously, regulatory frameworks are crystallizing globally. South Korea's Financial Supervisory Service is preparing comprehensive crypto market probes under its 2026 policy plan, while the Federal Reserve explores deeper integration through its "skinny master account" proposal. These developments signal a critical transition: from regulatory uncertainty to institutional clarity. This is precisely the environment where Web3 founders thrive. At Blockwall, we've witnessed how regulatory certainty unlocks institutional capital. Europe's MiCA framework and the DLT Pilot Regime overhaul have already catalyzed remarkable growth, our portfolio company Spiko scaled from $130 million to over $600 million in AUM this year alone, becoming Europe's leading tokenized money market fund issuer. The founders building infrastructure, identity solutions, and tokenized finance today are constructing the digital economy of tomorrow. Market resets separate the visionary builders from the speculators. They create the conditions for genuine innovation to flourish. We're actively backing the next generation of Web3 pioneers. If you're building solutions that solve real problems in crypto infrastructure, DeFi, or tokenized markets, we want to hear from you.
